scope: expansion-0231 through expansion-0235, 80 page illustrations plus 5 covers

visualReview.coverage: Read all five final text-ready manuscripts, all 80 page scenes, character specifications and editorial-006-older.md before drawing. Re-read all of 0234 after a combined output was truncated. Inspected all 85 first-draft frames in five contact sheets, all five final contact sheets, and the final 0232/0234 sheets again after their last changes. Enlarged 0231 p09/p11/p12/p14/p16; 0232 cover/p03/p06/p08/p09/p11/p13/p16; 0233 cover/p07/p11/p12/p14/p16; 0234 p01/p04/p10/p11/p12/p13/p14/p16; 0235 cover/p06/p10/p11/p15. Re-enlarged the revised twig/disc, vest, oar rig, deck provisions, high-chair eye level, tasting shell/loaves, recipe and seated sewing details.
corrections: 0231: removed duplicate blue button from the drawer once it is held; retained a single spare white button in the falling experiment; removed a pointer-like line from the vest inspection so the missing old thread is not reintroduced. The test twig rests on the table and its fork supports the string and wooden disc. Connected the willow twig to the tree and grounded the bench on the bank. Separate rolling, straight-falling and floating drawers, dry/wet leaves, empty vest slot, fish-marked button and preserved old thread remain visible.

0232: reversed the oar geometry and joined handles to both hands, with blades outside the hull; fitted the cover crop. Kept the single triangular magic sail full, limp or tied separately. Removed the premature installed rig from the measurement scene; shown the removable rig with pads and clasps only after building. Moved the child onto the dock, supported the journal and ruler, brought the held rig and bread bag to the hand, and stowed travel bottle, lunch, boxes and two oars on the deck. Lifejacket remains in the coastal rowing scene.

0233: raised the seated child onto the low window ledge; raised the high chair until her eyes reach the high window and left the feet dangling. Removed shoes in the final paper-house trial and moved the giant ant to a visible part of the little window. Added the shallow drawer to the plan only before construction, with collections still in a small box and old chest. Paper badger is enlarged relative to the shrunken child inside the paper house and thumb-sized outside; unfinished/modified/signed states remain separate.

0234: placed the stone baker behind the counter, supported the millstone and breads, turned the emerging baker toward the dough, and aligned the pencil with the recipe. Two fingers emerge through the small opening without an extra outside body. Three dough samples have zero/few/more peel pieces; tasting shows one whole and two divided loaves, rather than extra complete breads. Added a visible rim to the returning low shell, kept the opened low shell separate from the original intact resting shell, and moved stools behind the girl.

0235: reduced and moved the cover lion to preserve the tail within the crop; moved a loose pencil onto the stone plinth and removed a duplicate bag. Raised paw replaces one grounded leg rather than adding a fifth limb; the crescent mark remains on the left forepaw. The girl is absent from the independent reading page; selected missing words, circle marks, different letter layouts, coarse pencil, short reply and independent final reading are shown. Letter glyphs are simplified print representations, not full reproductions of handwriting.
visualReview.limits: Simplified original vector picture-book illustrations. Representative moments, frontal props and schematic rooms/boat geometry are used. Printed letter glyphs represent selected words and are not handwriting facsimiles. Review covers narrative continuity, visible anatomy, key props and overlaps; it does not certify bitmap painting, audio quality, browser layout, deployment or child-user testing.
